principles: Exact duplicate mirrors are not semantic conflicts.
Version number alone never adjudicates a scientific/technical claim.
Explicit execution supersession may decide artifact routing, not technical truth.
Technical conflicts survive until same-condition comparison, chronology/physics checks and source-quality comparison resolve them.
Historical branches remain preserved even when execution eligibility is revoked.
